project.name: AgentLab
project.description: AI agent testing, evaluation and security platform: ingests an agent, plans tests that fit it, runs them in isolation, evaluates in three layers and reports findings with severity, confidence and what was not tested.

commands.build: cd web && npm ci && npm run build
commands.test: pytest tests -q -m "not docker and not browser and not postgres and not redis and not ollama and not matrix"
commands.verify: python3 scripts/ai/validate_governance.py && python scripts/export_openapi.py --check && cd web && npm test

architecture.style: One Python package (src/agentlab) whose parts are plug-in registries, with a REST API, a command line and a React web interface served from the API's own origin. See docs/architecture.md.
